purpose: Expose evidenced legacy references and candidates while preserving requirement-dependent selections as OPEN.

status_definitions.LEGACY_REFERENCE: Exists in B1/Faz2/Faz3 and may be used for comparison; not automatically valid for U1.
status_definitions.CANDIDATE: Exact family or MPN has source-backed evidence but is not selected.
status_definitions.REVALIDATE: Function is likely reusable but rating/implementation must be re-proven against G1/G2.
status_definitions.BLOCKED_BY_G1: Cannot be selected until the system electrical envelope is frozen.
status_definitions.OPEN: No production-intent part may be selected yet.
status_definitions.REPLACE_IF_REQUIRED: Legacy implementation has a known issue or may be superseded after architecture closure.

Requires isolated/local bias and new creepage/CMTI/layout architecture.
Final MCU trade requires PWM/ADC timing, hardware trip, FOC execution and interface closure.
Exact orderable package remains open until executable control-platform trade closes.
100 V input-domain compatibility and actual U1 load depend on final transient envelope and load budget.

Requires a complete external power-stage design and evidenced load budget.
Final range/error/bandwidth/output sequencing and bench evidence remain open.
B1 rail-referenced implementation can back-power the analog/control rail.
Value/pulse/continuous rating cannot be accepted until phase RMS/peak current and PWM windows are frozen.
Final fault/re-arm policy, exact power sequencing and bench state testing remain open.
End-to-end fault-to-PWM-off latency and selected-driver safe-state behavior require physical proof.
Thresholds, sensing/filter delay and total fault latency depend on G1 current and final semiconductor safe-action budget.
Final protected-node relation, location, accuracy and U1 thermal limits remain open.

Exact protocol/data rate, harness/transient requirement, package/MPN, termination and external protection remain open.

Bus-pin limiting voltage is not treated as equivalent to TI bus-fault-protection ratings; final TVS/transient/harness and exact package suffix remain open.
Isolation is not justified until grounding/common-mode/fault-containment/EMC requirements freeze; isolated bus-side power and barrier layout would be required.

Unkeyed PoC header is not accepted as a final motor-temperature vehicle connector.
Exact capacitance, voltage, ESR, ripple, lifetime and transient energy depend on G1.
Effective capacitance under bias and final voltage/transient class remain open.
Cbus, VBUS, inrush, BMS/contact architecture and duty cycle are not frozen.
Regen/BMS-disconnect energy and allowable transient ceiling are not frozen.
Continuous/peak pack current and fault-clearing coordination are open.
Final voltage/current, harness gauge, temperature rise, mechanical and environmental requirements are open.
Fan/Hall/motor-temp/CAN/board-interface electrical and mechanical contracts remain open.

production_bom_release_rule: No item may be promoted to SELECTED_FOR_U1_PRODUCTION until its parent G1/G2 requirement is closed, exact orderable MPN/footprint is verified, derating evidence exists, and the schematic implementation is reviewed.
anti_hallucination_rule: null/Open fields remain null/Open. Legacy quantities or ratings are references only and must not be copied into U1 production BOM without requirement-backed requalification.
